announcements.headline: Profit Warning Announcement - Update

announcements.headline: Profit Warning Announcement
announcements.insight: Kakuzi's profit warning signals severe headwinds in the avocado supply chain, likely driven by South African logistics constraints and currency volatility, threatening shareholder returns in a sector already sensitive to climate and operational risks.
